info.name: TechNeest HRMS & Payroll Backend API
info.description: Complete importable Postman v2.1 collection for the TechNeest Employee Management, Self-Attendance, Approval Workflow, and Payroll Backend.

request.description:
Verify API service availability and version.

**Auth:** Public (None)
**Role/Permission:** None
**Business Rules:** Returns service status banner.

response.name: Example Error / Validation / Unauthorized Response

request.description:
Check MongoDB connection state, SMTP configuration readiness, and server timezone.

**Auth:** Public (None)
**Role/Permission:** None
**Business Rules:** Reports database connectivity ('connected'/'disconnected') and SMTP readiness.

Securely create the initial super_admin account without hardcoded credentials.

**Auth:** Public (Locked after first admin unless ADMIN_SETUP_KEY is provided)
**Role/Permission:** None (Bootstrap)
**Business Rules:** Fails with 403 if an admin already exists and setupSecretKey does not match process.env.ADMIN_SETUP_KEY.

response.name: Example Success Response
Example Error / Validation / Unauthorized Response

request.description:
Authenticate admin credentials (intended for frontend route /admin/login), issue JWT access + refresh tokens, and record LoginHistory & Session.

**Auth:** Public (Rate-limited)
**Role/Permission:** Admin account
**Business Rules:** Locks account for 15 minutes after 5 consecutive failed attempts. Records IP and device/browser metadata.

response.name: Example Error / Validation / Unauthorized Response

request.description:
Rotate refresh token and obtain a new short-lived access token and refresh token.

**Auth:** Refresh Token (Body or HTTP-only Cookie)
**Role/Permission:** Admin
**Business Rules:** Detects token reuse: if an old refresh token is replayed, the entire session is immediately revoked.

response.name: Example Error / Validation / Unauthorized Response

request.description:
Terminate current admin session, clear auth cookies, and record logout timestamp in LoginHistory.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** Authenticated Admin
**Business Rules:** Marks session status as LoggedOut and calculates total session duration.

response.name: Example Error / Validation / Unauthorized Response

request.description:
Fetch authenticated admin's profile, permissions, and current session ID.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** Authenticated Admin
**Business Rules:** Never exposes password hash or reset tokens.

Update admin display name.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** Authenticated Admin
**Business Rules:** Updates fullName on the authenticated admin profile.

response.name: Example Success Response

request.description:
Change authenticated admin's password after verifying current password.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** Authenticated Admin
**Business Rules:** Hashes new password with bcrypt (cost 12) and revokes other active sessions.

Generate a time-limited SHA-256 hashed password reset token and email it via SMTP.

**Auth:** Public (Rate-limited)
**Role/Permission:** None
**Business Rules:** Prevents email enumeration by returning 200 regardless of whether email exists. Token expires in 30m.

Reset admin password using the token received via email.

**Auth:** Public (Rate-limited)
**Role/Permission:** None
**Business Rules:** Clears lockout state, updates password hash, and revokes all active sessions.

response.name: Example Success Response
Example Error / Validation / Unauthorized Response

request.description:
View active and past login sessions for the authenticated admin.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** Authenticated Admin
**Business Rules:** Excludes refreshTokenHash from response.

Revoke a specific admin session by sessionId.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** Authenticated Admin
**Business Rules:** Immediately invalidates the session for future access or refresh requests.

Fetch paginated login audit history for admin accounts.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** Authenticated Admin
**Business Rules:** Includes successful, failed, and locked login attempts with IP and browser metadata.

response.name: Example Success Response

request.description:
Supply all data for /admin/dashboard and Sidebar Quick Stats (6 top cards, recent team activity, circular attendance overview, department-wise attendance progress).

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** dashboard:view
**Business Rules:** Aggregates live counts across Employee, Session, Task, Attendance, and Department collections.

response.name: Example Error / Validation / Unauthorized Response

request.description:
Search across employees, tasks, and departments from the Topbar search input.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** Authenticated Admin
**Business Rules:** Uses regex-escaped safe matching across employee names/IDs/emails, task titles, and departments.

Supply data for /admin/reports (Total Employees, Tasks Completed this week, Avg. Hours Logged, MON-FRI bar chart).

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** reports:view
**Business Rules:** Calculates average hours logged and daily task completions for the current week.

Export team productivity and attendance report as CSV.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** reports:view
**Business Rules:** Generates CSV with employee task completion and current month present days.

request.description:
Create a new employee account (supports /admin/employee/add) and initialize their SalaryStructure.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** employees:write
**Business Rules:** Auto-generates WB-XXX code if employeeId is 'Auto-generated' or omitted. Hashes password with bcrypt and creates SalaryStructure.

Fetch paginated employee directory with search, department, role, and status filters (/admin/employee).

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** employees:read
**Business Rules:** Excludes soft-deleted employees and never returns password hashes.

response.name: Example Error / Validation / Unauthorized Response

request.description:
Export employee directory as CSV (/admin/employee Export CSV button).

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** employees:read
**Business Rules:** Returns JSON with CSV string by default or raw text/csv stream when ?format=raw.

response.name: Example Success Response

item.name: Get Employee Details & Monthly Attendance Calendar

request.description:
Fetch full employee profile, task completion stats, salary structure, and full-month day-by-day attendance calendar (/admin/employee/:id).

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** employees:read
**Business Rules:** Accepts either Mongo _id or employeeId code (e.g. WB-024).

Update employee details, department, role, salary, or account settings (/admin/employee/edit/:id).

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** employees:write
**Business Rules:** Whitelists updatable fields to prevent mass assignment and syncs baseSalary with SalaryStructure.

Change employee account status between Active, Inactive, and Suspended.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** employees:write
**Business Rules:** Immediately revokes all active employee sessions when status is set to Inactive or Suspended.

Assign fine-grained permissions and role/designation to an employee.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** roles:manage
**Business Rules:** Audits role and permission changes.

response.name: Example Success Response

request.description:
Soft-delete an employee while preserving historical attendance and payroll records.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** employees:delete
**Business Rules:** Marks isDeleted=true, status='Inactive', and revokes active sessions.

Fetch uploaded documents (ID Proof, Offer Letter, Resume, etc.) for an employee.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** employees:read
**Business Rules:** Returns metadata array for employee documents.

Upload a document file (via multipart/form-data or metadata) for an employee.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** employees:write
**Business Rules:** Validates allowed MIME types and 5MB size limit.

response.name: Example Success Response
Example Error / Validation / Unauthorized Response

request.description:
Remove a specific document from an employee's record.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** employees:write
**Business Rules:** Removes subdocument by ID.

View login/logout timestamps, IP, device info, and session durations for a specific employee.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** employees:read
**Business Rules:** Shows both UTC timestamps and Asia/Kolkata formatted dates/times.

View monthly attendance summary, official register entries, and raw attendance submissions for an employee.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** attendance:read
**Business Rules:** Separates pending attendance submissions from approved official register entries.

Fetch historical monthly payroll records for a specific employee.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** payroll:read
**Business Rules:** Returns paginated payroll records ordered by period.

Filter and inspect employee login/logout records by date, employeeId, or session status.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** employees:read
**Business Rules:** Login activity is tracked separately from attendance; a login never auto-creates approved attendance.

List all currently active employee sessions with live duration, IP, and device/browser metadata.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** employees:read
**Business Rules:** Calculates live sessionDurationMinutes from loginAt to current UTC time.

Get daily login count, active sessions count, total session duration today, and last login per employee.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** employees:read
**Business Rules:** Reports times in Asia/Kolkata timezone.

Allow an admin to remotely terminate an active employee session.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** employees:write
**Business Rules:** Marks both Session and LoginHistory as Revoked.

Supply data for /admin/attendance-management (4 top stats cards, filters by date/department/status, employee rows with streak bar).

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** attendance:read
**Business Rules:** Returns Present Today, Absent, Late Arrivals, Hours Logged, and per-employee attendance status.

List all employee attendance records in 'Pending' or 'Correction Requested' state awaiting admin review.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** attendance:read
**Business Rules:** Only authorized admins can review and approve these records.

Approve or reject an attendance record or correction request with a reason. On approval, transfers the record into the official AttendanceRegister (main sheet).

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** attendance:approve
**Business Rules:** Upserts into AttendanceRegister with unique index { employee, attendanceDate } so duplicate approved entries are impossible. Creates permanent AttendanceAudit log and refreshes employee attendanceSummary.

Query the official approved attendance register (main sheet) used by the payroll engine.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** attendance:read
**Business Rules:** Contains only admin-approved attendance entries and approved paid/unpaid leaves.

View immutable audit history of check-ins, check-outs, correction requests, approvals, rejections, and manual adjustments.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** attendance:read
**Business Rules:** Preserves both previousState and newState for every attendance action.

response.name: Example Success Response

request.description:
Configure totalWorkingDays in month and update employee presentDays (powers Manual Adjustment modal in AttendanceManagement.jsx).

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** attendance:adjust
**Business Rules:** Clamps presentDays between 0 and totalWorkingDays, syncs AttendanceRegister, and records an AttendanceAudit entry.

Export daily attendance records as CSV (Export Attendance button in AttendanceManagement.jsx).

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** attendance:read
**Business Rules:** Exports check-in, check-out, duration, status, and approval status.

Run end-of-day job to mark active employees without check-in as Absent (when autoMarkAbsent is enabled in Settings).

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** attendance:adjust
**Business Rules:** Skips weekly offs and paid holidays; marks employees on approved leave as 'On Leave'.

Supply data for /admin/salary-management (Monthly Payroll, Pending Payments, Paid This Month cards, filters, and employee payroll rows).

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** payroll:read
**Business Rules:** Returns both summary card totals and detailed payroll rows.

Calculate or recalculate monthly draft payroll from SalaryStructure, approved AttendanceRegister entries, approved Leaves, and Holidays.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** payroll:run
**Business Rules:** Uses ONLY approved attendance and approved leaves. Skips already Finalized (immutable) payrolls to prevent overwriting.

View complete breakdown of a single payroll record and its associated payslip.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** payroll:read
**Business Rules:** Returns attendanceBreakdown, earnings, deductions, adjustmentsList, workflowStatus, paymentStatus, and immutableSnapshot.

Add a Bonus, Incentive, Allowance, or Deduction to a Draft/Approved payroll and recalculate netPayable.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** payroll:run
**Business Rules:** Blocked with 400 if payroll is already Finalized and immutable.

response.name: Example Success Response
Example Error / Validation / Unauthorized Response

request.description:
Mark a reviewed payroll record as Approved.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** payroll:approve
**Business Rules:** CRITICAL: Payroll approval updates workflowStatus to 'Approved' but NEVER automatically marks paymentStatus as 'Paid'.

response.name: Example Success Response

item.name: Finalize Payroll, Generate PDF Payslip & Send via SMTP

request.description:
Finalize payroll, lock an immutable snapshot, generate an employee-specific PDF salary slip, and email it via SMTP.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** payroll:finalize
**Business Rules:** Saves PDF securely outside public static URLs, creates Payslip record, and logs SMTP attempt in EmailLog.

response.name: Example Success Response

request.description:
Record actual salary disbursement status (Pending, Processing, Paid, Failed) and bank transfer reference.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** payroll:finalize
**Business Rules:** Requires payroll workflowStatus to be Approved or Finalized before marking paymentStatus as Paid.

response.name: Example Success Response
Example Error / Validation / Unauthorized Response

request.description:
Unlock a finalized unpaid payroll record using a mandatory audit reason so corrections can be made.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** payroll:finalize
**Business Rules:** Cannot reverse a payroll whose payment has already been disbursed (Paid).

response.name: Example Success Response
Example Error / Validation / Unauthorized Response

request.description:
Update base salaries and component rules for multiple employees (powers Edit Salary Structure modal in SalaryManagement.jsx).

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** payroll:run
**Business Rules:** Updates both Employee.baseSalary and SalaryStructure documents.

Export monthly payroll sheet as CSV (Export Payroll button in SalaryManagement.jsx).

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** payroll:read
**Business Rules:** Includes Employee ID, Name, Payable Days, Base Salary, Adjustments, Net Pay, Workflow Status, and Payment Status.

List all generated employee salary slips with SMTP delivery status.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** payslips:manage
**Business Rules:** Never exposes internal filesystem path in JSON responses.

Securely stream an employee's PDF salary slip to an authorized admin.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** payslips:manage
**Business Rules:** Protected by JWT + RBAC; payslips are never served via public static URLs.

Resend a generated PDF salary slip to the employee's registered email address.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** payslips:manage
**Business Rules:** Logs delivery attempt in EmailLog. If SMTP is unconfigured, preserves Pending state and returns configuration warning without crashing.

response.name: Example Success Response

request.description:
Inspect email delivery attempts, retry counts, statuses, and SMTP error messages.

**Auth:** Bearer Token (Admin)
**Role/Permission:** payslips:manage
**Business Rules:** Tracks PAYSLIP_DELIVERY and PASSWORD_RESET emails.

Load configuration for /admin/settings (loginTime, lateThreshold, logoutTime, autoAbsent, overtimeApproval, ipWhitelisting, emailNotifications, pushNotifications).

List paid and unpaid employee leave applications.

Approve or reject an employee leave application and sync with AttendanceRegister for payroll.

List configured paid/unpaid holidays for attendance and payroll calculations.

Add a holiday to the company calendar.
